wild_edge.name: Field Edge & Woods
wild_edge.desc: Always open: gather sticks, pick stones, pull wild weeds. What you gather comes at once; each spot refills after a Time Quiz question. Costs energy, never coins.

iron_hoe.name: Iron Hoe
iron_hoe.desc: Thistles come out root and all: weeding −45% energy.

steel_hoe.name: Steel Hoe
steel_hoe.desc: Even brambles give up: weeding −60% energy.

patch_dug.name: Dug beds
patch_dug.desc: Loosen the soil: 2 plants of the same crop fit in one patch.

patch_edged.name: Stick edging
patch_edged.desc: A woven stick border keeps weeds out: weeds grow 20% slower.

patch_raised.name: Raised log beds
patch_raised.desc: 3 plants per patch. Every plant beyond 2 needs 1 fertilizer point per planting (wood ash at first).

patch_stone.name: Stone borders & paths
patch_stone.desc: Weeds −15%, and paths make harvesting −10% energy.

patch_double.name: Double-dug beds
patch_double.desc: 4 plants per patch (2 fertilizer points per planting).

patch_channel.name: Irrigation channels
patch_channel.desc: Water flows from the pond to the roots: field water −15%.

patch_deep.name: Deep-worked beds
patch_deep.desc: 5 plants per patch (3 fertilizer points per planting).

patch_cloche.name: Glass cloches
patch_cloche.desc: Little glass hats keep seedlings warm: crops grow 15% faster.

patch_master.name: Living-soil beds
patch_master.desc: 6 plants per patch (4 fertilizer points per planting). The weeds love it too.

cottage_loft.name: Cottage · loft & second room
cottage_loft.desc: Energy max 40, 7 energy per Rest answer.

farmhouse_sunroom.name: Farmhouse · sun room
farmhouse_sunroom.desc: Energy max 65, 9 energy per Rest answer.

worm_bin.name: Worm Bin
worm_bin.desc: Worms turn compost and straw into castings worth 4 fertilizer points.

north_field_clear.name: North Field · clear the scrub
north_field_clear.desc: A second field to swipe to. First the scrub has to go.

north_field.name: North Field
north_field.desc: Fence it and it's yours: +9 field patches (they start at level 1 and need their own upgrades and scarecrow).

river_meadow_drain.name: River Meadow · drain the marsh
river_meadow_drain.desc: A third field by the river.

river_meadow.name: River Meadow
river_meadow.desc: Optional third field. A sluice from the river: +9 field patches and +2 water per question.
